description: This header file declares functions, macros, and structures related to 'rerere' (reuse recorded resolution) functionality in a version control system, likely Git. It provides interfaces for managing recorded conflict resolutions, paths, and related operations.

classes.name: rerere_id
classes.description: Represents a recorded conflict resolution identifier associated with a collection of rerere directory and variant.

methods.name: setup_rerere
methods.description: Initializes rerere state for a given repository, string list, and flags.

methods.name: repo_rerere
methods.description: Triggers rerere processing for the specified repository.

methods.name: rerere_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path related to a rerere ID and optional file component.

methods.name: rerere_forget
methods.description: Removes recorded resolutions associated with specific paths in a repository.

methods.name: rerere_remaining
methods.description: Checks for remaining rerere resolutions that need attention in a repository.

methods.name: rerere_clear
methods.description: Clears recorded rerere resolutions for a repository and string list.

methods.name: rerere_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of rerere data for a repository and string list.
